verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Mistral publishing benchmark methodology such as eval names with settings, harness details, or prompts. Model cards exist, and community posts mention LMArena rankings and Magistral benchmark comparisons, but none of this documents how the published benchmark claims can be reproduced or audited.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, published benchmark claims come with enough methodology — eval names, settings, harness or prompts — that I could reproduce or at least audit them
